The statement is admissible as an excited utterance under FRE 803(2), so I'm reversing my earlier answer. It describes the startling collision and was made moments later, while the pedestrian was still under its stress, and the circumstances (having just watched the crash) can supply the personal-knowledge foundation without identifying the declarant. The "careless driver" label is an opinion a court could trim, but the statement that the man failed to use a turn signal is a factual description of the event.

CONFIDENCE: 72
